turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What can I do for you today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi, yes. Thank you for seeing me. I just came in today because I've been having for the last week this cough and recently also started noticing that I've been having some diarrhea as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Hm, when did the cough start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: The cough started around 5 days ago. And it's it got worse, but now I think it's a little bit better.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What about the diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: The diarrhea started just two days ago and I'm having to go like almost 8 to 10 times in the last two days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And what is, what does your stool look like? Is it completely watery?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it's mostly watery.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And what colour is it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just normal colour, no, it's not dark or anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any blood that you've noticed, anything red?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And you've had this cough, but your cough is getting better. What's the cough like? Is it a dry cough or wet cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's uh, it's more of a dry cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you coughed up anything at all, like blood or any, any mucus?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no I haven't coughed up anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And other than the cough, have you had any other like flu like symptoms? Have you had like a runny nose or stuffy nose? Sore throat? Any of those symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, none of those. But I, I have also been having like a little bit of a headache as well in the last few days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Where is, where is your headache?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just in the like on my forehead, on both sides.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What does it feel like?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Aching sensation.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And how bad is your headache from 1 to 10, with 10 being the worst headache ever?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Right now, probably a 5, but it was probably like a 7 yesterday.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So do you feel like your headaches getting better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Right now, like today I took Tylenol so I don't know if it's just better because of that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. And have you taken any other medications to help with your symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, have you had a fever or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I know I haven't felt any fever, chills.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and have you had any chest pain or any difficulties breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, have you had any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any pain in your belly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um just like a little discomfort with going to the washroom so much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And any muscle aches in your body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any numbness or tingling in your arms or feet?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any change in your sense of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, maybe a little bit, I haven't really.. Yeah, I would say in the last few days, maybe a little like I've been able to smell less.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any change in your sense of taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you have you been in contact with someone who you think could potentially be sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, not that I know of. I do I do go to work in, like in person. Unfortunately I'm I can't work from home. But I've been noticing anyone sick around me though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And what do you do for work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I work at like a car shop.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you wear a mask and maintain social distancing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, most of the times I would say we're pretty strict, strict with that. Uhm, sometimes when we're in our office I take off my mask, but usually when we're seeing other people or within close proximity, we keep the masks on.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And, uh, do you, I, I guess, who do you live with at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I just live with my wife.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you think she might have had any exposures?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, she's been fine and she doesn't have any symptoms. And she's, she's a school teacher. Right now that she is working from Canada.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you, smoke at all? Or have you smoked in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, I do, or I used to smoke in my 20s and 30s, but I quit smoking.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How much did you smoke back then?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Probably half a pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And for how many years?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Only like 15, 15 years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK do you, do you smoke marijuana or have you smoked in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I've tried it a couple times. I don't really like it, so no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I probably have a beer every day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have any medical conditions that you've been diagnosed with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm I, I take uh, medications for blood pressure and high cholesterol.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What do you take?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I take this medication called, I think it's it's like a Lipitor. And then I take uh, Ramipril for the blood pressure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any allergies to food, environmental allergies or any medication allergies to medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not that I know of, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any medical conditions that run in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm so I think, uh, diabetes, and for my family, but I I I don't have it so and I think that's pretty much about it on my dad's side. On my mom's side and there was someone, like my aunt did have ovarian cancer.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you, I guess have you, I forgot to ask earlier, have you had any surgeries or hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm I had a surgery to remove my appendix in my 20s and since then, no. No surgeries or hospitalizations.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.  Alright, and I guess that's all the questions I have for you. You haven't had any difficulties breathing right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. Do you OK? And you've had diarrhea for two days. How's your appetite and have you been eating and drinking OK?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm appetites pretty OK, like I feel like, I've been more hungry, with the carry I feel like I, need to eat more.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uhm, It's also important with the diarrhea to drink lots of fluids and to make sure that you're not losing important minerals and you're not losing like sodium or potassium in diarrhea and other things like calcium that could create problems. So, continue to eat well and continue to drink lots of water. I guess so what we'll do is we'll do a COVID swab just to just to check if you have COVID or not. We'll also do a few labs to see how your electrolytes are, do your vitals to see if you have fever, measure your heart rate and do a physical exam and then go from there. And I'll off - I'll talk to my attending as well and we'll come back and discuss the management plan with you.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, sounds good. Thank you so much.
